findings.title: Migration 006 edited despite non-goal
findings.problem: The spec listed changes to migrations 006/008 as a non-goal, but 006 had hookFiles made protected and a writeHooks method added so 012 can subclass it. Runtime behavior appears unchanged.
findings.impact: No behavior consequence seen; the question is whether the spec deviation was intended.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the 006 refactor is intended, or note it in the PR description.

findings.title: No retry on rename lock
findings.problem: On Windows, fs.rename over hooks.json can fail EPERM/EBUSY if Gemini or antivirus holds the file open; the migration reports write-failed with no retry.
findings.impact: Trigger is a transient lock during migration; hooks keep opening console windows until a later run. Workaround: re-run.
findings.recommendation: Optionally retry rename up to 3 times with a short delay before failing.
findings.check_notes: 012 migration.ts renameWithRetry retries fs.rename up to 3 attempts on EPERM/EBUSY with 50ms*attempt backoff; other errors rethrow; tmp cleaned up.
